title: Motor imagery BCI dataset with pupillometry augmentation
description: A motor imagery brain-computer interface dataset comprising EEG recordings from 30 healthy subjects performing left-hand grasping imagery and rest tasks, augmented with pupillometry measurements. The dataset includes 32-channel EEG data sampled at 512 Hz acquired using BioSemi ActiveTwo hardware, with synchronized pupil diameter measurements to investigate the relationship between task-evoked pupillary responses and motor imagery performance.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired from 30 healthy subjects using a 32-channel BioSemi ActiveTwo system (biosemi32 montage) at 512 Hz sampling rate with CMS/DRL reference. Subjects performed two sessions of motor imagery tasks (left-hand grasping vs. rest) cued by auditory stimuli, with each session containing 2 blocks of 25 trials each (6-second trial duration). Pupil diameter was recorded simultaneously to augment the EEG-based BCI. Data were processed using Common Spatial Patterns (CSP) for feature extraction and Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) for classification, with 10-fold cross-validation for evaluation.
